notes: This is the most common way to say 'to help' in Hindi. It is a compound verb formed by the noun 'मदद' (help) and the light verb 'करना' (to do).
When helping someone, use the postposition 'की' before 'मदद करना' (e.g., 'उसकी मदद करो' - help him/her).
